'''Tabage''' were quadrupedal creature native to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. Their [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] were covered by narrow slits, and they had small, pointy [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. They were the prey of the [[dalyrake]].
